tours.title: The Renaissance & Its Legacy
tours.description: From proportion and perspective to dramatic light and the enduring study of humanity.

stops.title: The School of Athens
stops.note: Observe how architecture and perspective organize the gathering of thinkers.

stops.title: The Art of Painting
stops.note: Compare the carefully composed interior with the Renaissance interest in representation.

stops.title: Vitruvian Man
stops.note: Consider how drawing becomes a way to investigate the proportions of the human body.

tours.title: The History of Human Imagination
tours.description: A journey through changing ways to represent the world, across five galleries.

stops.title: Mona Lisa
stops.note: Look at the subtle transitions of light and expression.

stops.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
stops.note: Notice the concentrated light and direct encounter with the figure.

stops.title: Wanderer Above the Sea of Fog
stops.note: Consider the relationship between the lone figure and the vast landscape.

stops.title: Impression, Sunrise
stops.note: Observe how brushwork and color suggest the changing atmosphere.

stops.title: Black Square
stops.note: Ask what an artwork can communicate when recognizable subject matter is removed.

tours.title: Art Meets Science
tours.description: Explore observation, experiment, anatomy and the visual culture of scientific inquiry.

stops.title: A Philosopher Lecturing on the Orrery
stops.note: Notice how the light source and the group of observers turn a demonstration into a shared experience.

stops.title: Vitruvian Man
stops.note: Study the relationship between geometric figures and bodily proportions.

stops.title: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp
stops.note: Look at how the painter arranges the demonstration and its observers.

stops.title: Portrait of Albert Einstein (1917)
stops.note: Reflect on how a portrait represents the person behind scientific ideas.

stops.title: Nikola Tesla (Blue Portrait)
stops.note: Consider the contrast between scientific achievement and the artistic language of portraiture.

tours.title: The Architects of Reality
tours.description: A reflective route through philosophy, the sublime, physics and invention.

stops.title: The Death of Socrates
stops.note: Consider how gesture and composition present a philosophical choice.

stops.title: Wanderer Above the Sea of Fog
stops.note: Reflect on the limits of human perspective in the face of the unknown.

stops.title: Albert Einstein (1924)
stops.note: Consider how artistic portraiture connects abstract ideas with a human presence.

stops.title: Isaac Newton
stops.note: Compare this portrait with the Tesla portrait nearby and reflect on changing models of the physical world.
